comment: The fleet model chain's ONE source (issue #1140). ORDER IS THE CONTRACT: exactly one role=primary first, one or more role=fallback entries in list order, exactly one role=last_resort LAST. `make agent-profile-model-render` renders every lane's profile config from this file; `make agent-model-chain-check` refuses drift. A credential is a NAME only (AGENTS.md rule 3e): `key_env`, never a value.
